name: Venmax Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited
about: Venmax Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited engages in the business of pharmaceutical products, drug intermediaries, and API's in India. The company was formerly known as Yenkey Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd and changed its name to Venmax Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited in April 2009. Venmax Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
